title: HTML & CSS Basics
intro: HTML and CSS are the skeleton and skin of every frontend application. Interviewers for fullstack roles test whether you know the semantic HTML elements that matter for SEO and accessibility, how CSS layout models like Flexbox and Grid actually work, and whether you can write responsive, accessible markup. For Java backend developers stepping into fullstack roles, this module bridges the gap between what you build on the server and how it gets presented in the browser.
